# Functions

```{r, echo=FALSE}
read_rgb <- function(path) {
    img <- if (grepl("\\.png$", path, ignore.case = TRUE))
                png::readPNG(path)
           else 
               jpeg::readJPEG(path)
  img[, , 1:3]
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
shrink_image_res <- function(path, 
                             max_px = 600, 
                             dir = file.path(tempdir(), "shrunk")) {
    
    # Create tmp directory
    dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
    
    # Read image
    img <- imager::load.image(path)
    
    # f is the resize factor to transform a 2480 × 3508 scan to 424 × 600
    f <- min(1, max_px / max(dim(img)[1:2]))
    
    # Image path
    out <- file.path(dir, sub("\\.[^.]+$", ".png", basename(path)))
    
    # Resize the image
    imager::save.image(imager::imresize(img, 
                                        scale = f, 
                                        
                                        # nearest neighbour
                                        interpolation = 1), out)
    
    return(out)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
iscc_family <- c(
                # Classified as healthy
                green = "green",
                 
                # Classified as transitional
                yellow = "yellow", olive = "yellow", "yellow green" = "yellow", 
                 
                # Classified as senescence
                brown = "brown", orange = "brown", red = "brown", pink = "brown",  
                 
                # Classified as background
                gray = "grey", white = "white", black = "black",     
                 
                # reported, not expected
                blue = "other", purple = "other", violet = "other")           
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

iscc_label <- function(matrix_of_colours) {
    
    iscc_color_name <- ColorBlockFromMunsell(RGBtoMunsell(matrix_of_colours, 
                                             space = "sRGB", 
                                             maxSignal = 255))$Name
    # Extracts the hue family
    fam  <- ifelse(grepl("yellow green$", iscc_color_name), 
                 "yellow green", sub(".* ", "", iscc_color_name))
  
    # Looks each family up in your table
    cls  <- unname(iscc_family[fam])
  
    # Stop if color is not found 
    if (any(is.na(cls))) stop("unmapped ISCC-NBS name: ",
                              iscc_color_name[is.na(cls)][1])
  
    # Return data
    data.frame(iscc = iscc_color_name, class = cls)
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
classify_scan <- function(path, max_px = 600) {
    
    # Shrink_image_res?
    src <- if (is.null(max_px)) path else shrink_image_res(path, max_px)
    
    # Run Charisma
    res <- charisma(src, threshold = 0, interactive = FALSE, pavo = FALSE)
    
    # Per-cluster table
    # Remove the first row which corresponds to the transparent background
    lut <- res$color_mask_LUT[-1, ]
    
    # Picks the RGB values from  the lut table and assign ISCC-NBS name and 
    # the study class defined in the iscc_family() and append them to lut as 
    # the iscc and class columns
    res$iscc_lut <- cbind(lut, iscc_label(as.matrix(lut[, c("r", "g", "b")])))
    
    # Add image name
    res$source   <- path
    
    return(res)
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
leaf_summary <- function(x, max_px = 600, background = c("white", "grey", "black")) {
  
    # Is the object an image or a charisma object
    res  <- if (inherits(x, "charisma")) x
            else classify_scan(x, max_px)
    
    # Get look-up table (lut) 
    # Table you consult to translate one thing into another, rather than 
    # compute it each time. charisma uses the abbreviation in color_mask_LUT 
    # because that table is how it translates a cluster index into a colour 
    # and a label: pixel says "cluster 7", the table says what cluster 7 is.
    lut  <- res$iscc_lut
    
    # Calculate quantities 
    prop <- tapply(lut$prop, lut$class, sum)
    leaf <- prop[!names(prop) %in% background]
    frac <- leaf / sum(leaf)
    get  <- function(k) sum(frac[names(frac) %in% k])
    
    # Create data frame
    data.frame(file = basename(res$source),
               leaf_cover   = sum(leaf),
               green_frac   = get("green"), 
               yellow_frac  = get("yellow"),
               brown_frac   = get("brown"), 
               other_frac   = get("other"),
               shadow_cover = sum(prop[names(prop) == "black"]))
}
```

```{r}
plot_check <- function(res, alpha = 0.55,
                       cols = c(green = "#2ca02c", 
                                yellow = "#ffdd00", 
                                brown = "#8b4513",
                                other = "#0000ff", 
                                black = "#ff00ff")) {
  img <- read_rgb(res$path)
  stopifnot(all(dim(img)[1:2] == dim(res$pixel_assignments)))
  lut <- res$iscc_lut
  cls <- lut$class[match(res$pixel_assignments, lut$assignment_class)]
  ov  <- img
  hit <- cls %in% names(cols)
  rgb <- t(col2rgb(cols[cls[hit]])) / 255
  for (k in 1:3) {
    ch <- ov[, , k]
    ch[hit] <- (1 - alpha) * ch[hit] + alpha * rgb[, k]
    ov[, , k] <- ch
  }
  op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0)); on.exit(par(op))
  plot(as.raster(img)); title("original")
  plot(as.raster(ov));  title("classified")
}
```

# Analysis


```{r}
plot_check(single_image)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}

```


## Batch processing

```{r, get_file_names, evaL = FALSE}
files <- list.files("./original_images/", 
                    
                    # Get only images containing leaves
                    pattern = "leaves.*\\.(jpe?g|png)$",
                    full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

```

```{r, batch_processing, evaL = FALSE}
raw_[spcode]_colors <- do.call(rbind,
                               parallel::mclapply(files, leaf_summary,
                                                  mc.cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1))
```

# Data cleaning

```{r,data_cleaning,  evaL = FALSE}
#[spcode]_colors %>% 

    raw_[spcode]_colors %>% 
    
    # Separate file name from file extension
    separate_wider_delim(file, delim = ".", names = c("file_name", 
                                                      "file_extension")) %>%  

    # Create the vpd_control column based on whether "no-vpd-control" is present
    mutate(vpd_control = ifelse(grepl("no-vpd-control", file_name),
                                "no-vpd-control", 
                                "vpd_controlled")) %>% 

    # Remove "no-vpd-control_" from file_name to standardize the format
    mutate(file_name_clean = gsub("no-vpd-control_", "", file_name)) %>% 
    
    # Remove the .jpg extension
    mutate(file_name_clean = gsub("\\.jpg$", "", file_name_clean)) %>% 
    
    # Separate the cleaned filename into components
    separate(file_name_clean, into = c( "genera", "specie", "month", 
                                       "tree_id", "set_temperature", "organ",
                                       
                                       "image_number"), sep = "_") %>% 

    # Select and reorder columns as desired
    select(file_name, genera, specie, 
           month, tree_id, vpd_control, set_temperature, 
           organ, image_number, everything()
           ) %>% 

   # Unite Genera and specie columns
    unite("spcode", genera:month, sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 

    # Remove leading zeros inside column
    mutate(tree_id = as.numeric(str_remove(tree_id, "^0+")),

           # Remove the last character in set_temperature column
           set_temperature = as.numeric(str_sub(set_temperature, end = -2))) %>%

    # Remove unused columns
    select(-c(file_extension)) %>% 

    group_by(spcode, tree_id, set_temperature, organ, vpd_control) %>% View()

```
